segments.label: Selected live order; implemented locally, real full coverage unqualified
Canonical replay: scripted wet/dry proof; live qualification open
Failure and restart: charged originals, bounded recovery

messages.label: Discover required originals
messages.note: Real bounded LIST and catalog checks stay inside latency. No initial grid head.

messages.label: Reserve provider quota
messages.note: Reserve retained bytes before HTTP. Quota/control I/O remains on the request path.

messages.label: Complete original groups
messages.note: City/hourly require exact header time; no form echo. Writer owns charged originals before RamReady.

messages.label: Pinned full input closure
messages.note: ASOS primary; ODAM/VSRT cover elapsed hours. Preserve public 3h slots; past SHRT/RSS weather is removed.

messages.label: Coverage and value result
messages.note: Integrity, required fields/hours and parity are separate gates. Missing history fails full-response qualification.

messages.label: Full required response
messages.note: Conditional full-success branch. Current sources are unqualified; no new client failure API is implied.

messages.label: Eligible body terminal
messages.note: Use the declared server hook, not claimed app receipt. Freeze waiters; bound dormancy and shutdown.

messages.label: Persist original group
messages.note: One supervised writer; exact bytes, original owners, CAS and verified publication after response.

messages.label: Normal canonical discovery
messages.note: Count LIST, catalogs, descriptors and raw. Provider fallback is disabled in the restore test.

messages.label: Same full value assembly
messages.note: Run the same value assembly from original canonical groups. Per-grid combination generation remains deferred.

messages.label: Coverage and replay checks
messages.note: Scripted wet/dry history replays exactly. Real QC9, winter and pre-release coverage is not yet qualified.

messages.label: If write fails: retry same raw
messages.note: Retain charged bytes; bounded retries and drain. Dormant batches hold no writer slots.

messages.label: Read and bounded repair
messages.note: Protect discovery generations through promotion/removal. Never combine different vintages.

messages.label: If gap: qualified reacquisition
messages.note: Source-specific reach and new identity. Accepted crash loss never waives required response history.

cards.title: Full-response qualification is open
items: Seven completed days and current public 3h slots stay required; historical numbers may change from acquired ASOS.
Scripted wet/dry history proves response-before-raw-PUT and replay. Real QC9, winter, pre-release and p95/p99 remain open.
ASOS normal blanks mean dry; trace0 stays precipitation. Apr-Oct QC9 hours on closed days read dry (dry-closure-v1); winter QC9 and midnight gaps remain.
Apr-Oct uncoded rain at wet-bulb 5C or more reads rain; other untyped rain never reads dry: slot PTY -1, AM/PM omitted (history contract v1).
A town reads a station within 200 m of its elevation, or none (station-altitude-v1); island stations serve only their county.

cards.title: Client first; owned raw afterwards
items: Writer owns charged raw before Ready; server body end/drop, no waiters, a10s cap or shutdown releases S3 publication.
Default virtual reservation768MiB, shrunk to actual retained bytes; retries preserve originals. S16 waits for a frozen durability fence after the body.

cards.title: Canonical reuse; conditional candidates
items: Canonical v2 raw/catalog/group controls remain the restore authority. Same selected original closure must replay exactly.
Per-grid optimal combinations, source plans, day locators, heads and packs remain deferred. No live full-response timing is qualified.
